job.sentence: Nothing here is new material — what is new is STATUS. 1 form(s) that the course had only ever made available as glue now become LEGOs with baskets of their own: "habría" (L01) was bundled at seed 152 — "lo habría hecho".

phrases.known_text: I would have
phrases.why: bare stem of the LEGO with no neighbours, the anchor form

phrases.known_text: I would have said
phrases.why: adds a right neighbour, habría still phrase-initial

phrases.known_text: I think that I would have
phrases.why: embeds under matrix think/believe, habría now phrase-final with left neighbour que

phrases.known_text: I would have done it
phrases.why: clitic lo gives habría a new left neighbour, medial position

phrases.known_text: I would have done something
phrases.why: swaps the verb after habría from dicho to hecho, new junction

phrases.known_text: if I had known, I would have said something
phrases.target_text: si hubiera sabido, habría dicho algo
phrases.why: full double-'d conditional, left neighbour sabido is new

phrases.known_text: he knew that I would have said something
phrases.why: matrix know/sure frame, habría stays first person inside the embedded clause

phrases.known_text: after you left, I would have said something
phrases.target_text: después de que te fuiste, habría dicho algo
phrases.why: temporal clause frame, left neighbour fuiste is new

phrases.known_text: I think that I would have done the same thing
phrases.target_text: pienso que habría hecho lo mismo
phrases.why: think/believe frame with hecho instead of dicho, new junction que->hecho

phrases.known_text: been happy
phrases.why: bare stem of the LEGO

phrases.known_text: I'd have been happy here
phrases.why: adds a locative tail

phrases.known_text: I'd have been happy with something
phrases.why: adds a prepositional complement

phrases.known_text: I'd have been happy to come back
phrases.why: infinitive complement, bare counterfactual

phrases.known_text: if it had been my choice, I'd have been happy to help
phrases.target_text: si hubiera sido mi decisión, habría estado encantado de ayudar
phrases.why: full if-clause frame not present in the live basket

phrases.known_text: he said that he'd have been happy to come
phrases.target_text: dijo que habría estado encantado de venir
phrases.why: matrix say/tell frame absent from the live basket

phrases.known_text: before you go, I'd have been happy to explain
phrases.target_text: antes de que te vayas, habría estado encantado de explicar
phrases.why: temporal clause frame absent from the live basket

phrases.known_text: I think that I'd have been happy there
phrases.target_text: pienso que habría estado encantado allí
phrases.why: think/believe frame absent from the live basket

phrases.known_text: to drive
phrases.why: bare stem of the LEGO

phrases.known_text: I want to drive
phrases.why: want-chain frame, conducir phrase-final

phrases.known_text: I need to drive
phrases.why: need-to frame, distinct matrix verb from want

phrases.known_text: I'd have been happy to drive
phrases.why: ties the counterfactual frame back into this LEGO

phrases.known_text: I have to drive
phrases.why: have-to frame, present tense obligation

phrases.known_text: I wanted to drive home
phrases.why: past want-chain with a directional tail

phrases.known_text: you need to drive there
phrases.why: second-person need-to, new left neighbour necesitas

phrases.known_text: it's important to drive carefully
phrases.why: it's-adjective frame absent elsewhere in the basket

phrases.known_text: to drive in a safe way
phrases.why: conducir phrase-initial with a manner tail

phrases.known_text: I'm too tired to drive
phrases.why: predicate-adjective result frame, para instead of de

phrases.known_text: you are willing to drive
phrases.why: predicate-adjective frame with a different preposition, a

phrases.known_text: you'd told
phrases.why: bare stem of the LEGO, no neighbours

phrases.known_text: if you'd told
phrases.why: adds si as left neighbour, hubieras phrase-final

phrases.known_text: if you'd told her
phrases.why: le replaces si as immediate left neighbour

phrases.known_text: if you'd told me, I would have said something
phrases.target_text: si me hubieras dicho, habría dicho algo
phrases.why: me as left neighbour, dicho as right neighbour, full double-'d conditional

phrases.known_text: if you'd told him, I would have been happy
phrases.target_text: si le hubieras dicho, habría estado encantado
phrases.why: le+dicho junction, apodosis swapped to been-happy LEGO

phrases.known_text: if you'd told the truth, I would have been happy
phrases.target_text: si hubieras dicho la verdad, habría estado encantado
phrases.why: no object clitic before hubieras, new si->dicho junction

phrases.known_text: if you'd told me, I would have been happy to drive
phrases.target_text: si me lo hubieras dicho, habría estado encantado de conducir
phrases.why: lo as left neighbour, ties all four LEGOs of the seed together

phrases.known_text: if you'd told her something, I would have done the same thing
phrases.target_text: si le hubieras dicho algo, habría hecho lo mismo
phrases.why: apodosis swapped to the done-the-same construction from L01
